item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Database for PostgreSQL enhanced Burstable tier (Basv2)
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL now has a public preview of the enhanced Burstable tier (Basv2). It keeps the burstable model but adds improved performance predictability and more efficient burst utilization for steadier, lower-cost workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL Managed Instance updates for mid-November 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL Managed Instance received mid-November 2026 updates, including higher transaction throughput for Next-gen General Purpose instances with log rates up to 220 MiB/s and increased performance. The release is generally available.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Improved Apache AGE graph query and ingestion performance on Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now includes generally available Apache AGE performance improvements for graph querying and knowledge graph ingestion. The update speeds up eligible read queries through better query planning and graph joins, and improves duplicate detection and memory handling during graph build operations.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: commandline: Building modern agentic applications with Microsoft Copilot SDK 2.0
item.description:
Microsoft Copilot SDK 2.0 adds runtime enhancements for multi-tenant, high-performance agentic applications. The post focuses on helping developers choose an architecture that fits their agentic use case.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.108
item.description:
Release v1.0.108 adds numerous CLI behavior fixes, help-text updates, and MCP/autopilot improvements. Notable changes include better session/resume handling, more consistent permission and tool-call behavior, improved search and transcript rendering, and default installation/activation for managed plugins marked defaultEnabled.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: ABFS Vectored Read for Azure Data Lake Storage
item.description:
ABFS Vectored Read is now generally available for Azure Data Lake Storage. It reduces request overhead for selective reads by batching nearby file ranges into fewer asynchronous storage requests.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: dotnet: A faster, lighter C# Dev Kit
item.description:
C# Dev Kit has been rebuilt to open solutions in about one second and use significantly less memory. The post says it explains the changes behind those improvements.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL Performance Monitoring for Azure SQL Database
item.description:
Microsoft has opened public preview of managed SQL performance monitoring for Azure SQL Database. It provides built-in monitoring so you do not need custom data collection scripts or manual correlation across separate tools.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Support for large volume breakthrough mode
item.description:
Azure NetApp Files large volume breakthrough mode is now generally available. It adds support for volumes up to 2 PiB and throughput up to 80 GiB/s, depending on workload characteristics.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: dotnet: Performance Improvements in .NET 11
item.description:
The post says .NET 11 includes hundreds of performance improvements and invites readers to review them in detail. No specific runtime, libraries, or API changes are listed in the provided text.
